hypothesis.name: Kneser
evidence: receivers = 1378 and degree_min = degree_max = 1275, so the graph is regular; C(53,2) = 1378 and C(51,2) = 1275
spectrum_integral is true with 3 distinct eigenvalues [1275, 1, -50], as for a strongly regular graph; Kneser K(53,2) has eigenvalues 1275, 1, -50

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 52 for the 1378-receiver graph. The lower bound 52 is an independent set; the upper bound 52 is a linear code over F_7 with c = 6 (it fits, factorizes and decodes). All four checks pass. The agent took 27.388 s wall, of which 26.916 s was LLM time and 0.472 s compute, with 2 LLM calls and 1 critic round. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha also reached 52 and proved it, but in 90.7 s. CP-SAT cover (62) and fractional cover (59.98) were unproven at the 120 s limit. F2 min-rank SAT only gave 51 as a lower bound. The rule-based kushagra_agent also proved 52 over F_7, in 0.683 s, so it was faster than this agent. Nothing suspicious.
